# ui::testing::TestRenderer

Header: `winui/testing/TestRenderer.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::Renderer`.

[Renderer](../rendering/renderer.md) test double that records every draw call as a [RenderCommand](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#rendercommand) instead of painting.

This is the headless testing boundary: any [Element](../tree/element.md) can render() into it without a native window, a GPU or a desktop session, and the resulting command stream is deterministic. Each override appends exactly one command of the matching alternative; images and SVGs are recorded by their natural size only, never their pixels. render/Describe.hpp turns the stream into the text used by the semantic golden files.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::ButtonControl       button{"Hello"};
ui::testing::TestRenderer renderer;
button.render(renderer); // Theme::default_light() by default

REQUIRE(renderer.count() == 3); // background, elevation border, label
REQUIRE(std::holds_alternative<ui::FillRoundedRect>(renderer.commands[0]));
REQUIRE(renderer.count_of<ui::DrawTextRun>() == 1);
REQUIRE(std::get<ui::DrawTextRun>(renderer.commands[2]).text == "Hello");

renderer.clear(); // reuse for the next frame
```

## commands

```cpp
std::vector<RenderCommand> commands
```

Every recorded command, in draw order. Public so tests can index and `std::get` directly.

## scale

```cpp
float scale = 1.0f
```

What [device_scale()](#device_scale) reports, 1 by default: set it to test a mark drawn per device pixel at another DPI (1.5 for 144 DPI).
